text:
Maya Chen: quick sync — we need to lock the identity + image + licensing bits for the cloud store entry this week. AWS/GCP/Azure initial checklist attached in the doc: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/onboard-checklist
Oliver Park: I can own AWS IAM role + AMI naming. want to confirm trust policy and tagging before I spin images.
Jordan Reyes: i'll take GCP image + offer manifest composition (SKU mapping + trial flags). also will coordinate the storefront screenshots with marketing.
Maya Chen: thanks. Elaine, legal: do we have any updates on the EULA language for marketplace variants (trial vs paid)? any required marketplace-specific clauses?
Elaine (Legal): short answer: one EULA can cover all three clouds but need a marketplace appendix that calls out telemetry + support SLAs and trial length. i'll drop a draft appendix by EOD. note: for azure we need a separate distributable terms checkbox during publish.
Oliver Park: copying the trust policy i'm planning to use for AWS role — can you confirm it's OK?
Oliver Park: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "Service": "marketplace.amazonaws.com" },
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```
Elaine (Legal): structure looks fine. add a short comment in the doc that this role is scoped to marketplace events only. also add rotation note for the role credentials.
Jordan Reyes: for GCP i'll create a service account with the minimal roles and attach a signed policy to the manifest. will post the exact IAM commands.
Maya Chen: billing / SKU question — finance needs canonical product codes. Jordan can you propose SKU naming? prefer short, stable IDs (ex: RDW-INFR-<region>-<tier>).
Jordan Reyes: yep — draft: RDW-INFR-AWS-STD, RDW-INFR-AWS-PRO, RDW-INFR-GCP-STD, etc. will put full mapping in the manifest and link to the trial entitlements.
marketplace-bot: reminder: before publish, run the validation script `tools/marketplace/validate_manifest.sh` — see pipeline docs.
Oliver Park: I will push AMI images to the staging account tomorrow morning and tag with `release:marketplace-staging`. after Elaine's appendix is in, i'll update the image descriptions.
Maya Chen: action items: Oliver = AWS IAM + AMI (owner), Jordan = GCP image + SKU manifest (owner), Elaine = EULA appendix (owner). I'll coordinate Azure packaging and the final publish window. target: ready for staging publish on Thu.
Elaine (Legal): acknowledged. i'll post the appendix and quick checklist with the checkbox for the Azure distributable terms.
Jordan Reyes: FYI — need a quick confirmation on support contact email for the listing page. who should we direct to?
Maya Chen: Use partners-support@redwood.ai for listing; we'll map to on-call rotations in the console later.
Oliver Park: noted. if anyone needs the AMI build command: `packer build -var-file=aws-staging.pkrvars.hcl redwood-ami.pkr.hcl`
Maya Chen: perfect. i'll follow up with a short publish runbook once Elaine drops the EULA appendix. thanks all :thumbsup:
